arguments.note: 10 Oct 12:09 tenant emailed again: tap now drips constantly even when fully closed (worse than at booking). Duplicate, no new job. Visit 15 Oct 08:00-12:00 with Swift Plumbing & Heating stands. Contractor to be told of worsening; sooner slot requested if available.

arguments.body: Hello Amelia, thanks for letting us know. Your dripping tap is already logged (ref R-4801) and Swift Plumbing & Heating are booked to visit on Thursday 15 October, 8am-12pm. I haven't opened a second job, but I've added your update that it's now dripping constantly to the existing one and will ask the plumber if they can come sooner. I'll only confirm a new date once they agree it. In the meantime, if there's a small valve on the pipe under the sink, you can turn it off to stop the drip, and a bowl underneath will help. If water ever starts running or leaking elsewhere, please tell us straight away. Is the 15th still OK for you? You'll hear from us again by Monday 12 October.

arguments.purpose: Confirm whether sooner slot than 15 Oct is possible given tap worsening; update tenant
